query: SELECT ls.id, ls.periodoCustoId, ls.contaCustoId, ls.setorId, s.nome as setorNome, ls.valor, ls.observacoes FROM lancamento_salario ls LEFT JOIN setores s ON ls.setorId = s.id WHERE ls.contaCustoId = 1 AND ls.periodoCustoId = 90001 ORDER BY ls.setorId;
